visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty nine: now do last year (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js attic under a pitched roof with rafters, a round window with rain streaks, cardboard boxes with labels, a rocking horse, a trunk, a dress form and a hanging bulb, an old desk with a laptop that turns round to face the camera, twenty candles that light one by one after a crate of them lands, a shoebox that opens on a sneaker, box-built creator with a platinum pixie cut, mustard hoodie and a pencil behind her ear, phone sheets for an accountant chat / bank statement / payment app / earnings page / invoices, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.85 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: tax time in an attic. Her accountant wants one number, what she earned this year. Brand one paid by bank transfer (the statement just says TRANSFER), brand two through an app (it says Kevin), brand three in candles. The shoebox of receipts is shoes. Then YourBrand: every campaign on one earnings page, every payout request makes an invoice, marked paid. She shows her accountant one page. He writes back: great. Now do last year.
